import datetime,json,re,subprocess,sys
from pathlib import Path
ci,review=sys.argv[1:]
assert re.fullmatch('[0-9a-f]{40}',ci)
registry=json.loads(Path('docs/checks/release-registry-0.2.2.json').read_text())
source=registry['sourceCommit'];tag='v0.2.2'
assert subprocess.check_output(['git','cat-file','-t','refs/tags/'+tag],text=True).strip()=='tag'
obj=subprocess.check_output(['git','rev-parse','refs/tags/'+tag],text=True).strip()
assert subprocess.check_output(['git','rev-parse','refs/tags/'+tag+'^{}'],text=True).strip()==source
remote='ssh://git@git-ssh.cdot.io/cdot/scm-sdk-rs.git'
ssh='ssh -F /dev/null -i /home/cdot/.ssh/forgejo -o IdentitiesOnly=yes -o BatchMode=yes -o StrictHostKeyChecking=yes'
lines=subprocess.check_output(['git','-c','core.sshCommand='+ssh,'ls-remote',remote,'refs/heads/main','refs/tags/'+tag,'refs/tags/'+tag+'^{}'],text=True).splitlines()
refs={line.split('\t')[1]:line.split('\t')[0] for line in lines}
assert refs=={'refs/heads/main':ci,'refs/tags/'+tag:obj,'refs/tags/'+tag+'^{}':source}
r={'schemaVersion':1,'checkedAt':datetime.datetime.now(datetime.timezone.utc).isoformat(),'remote':remote,'tag':tag,'tagObject':obj,'sourceCommit':source,'remoteRefs':refs,'cleanPackageProofs':['docs/checks/phase-20-release-package-'+v+'.json' for v in ['1.89.0','1.99.0']],'sourceReview':review,'registryReceipt':'docs/checks/release-registry-0.2.2.json','passed':True}
Path('docs/checks/release-tag-v0.2.2.json').write_text(json.dumps(r,indent=2)+'\n')
print(json.dumps({'passed':True,'tag':tag,'sourceCommit':source,'remoteMain':ci}))
